molecules.name: LDL cholesterol (LDL-C)
molecules.label_th: แอลดีแอล คอเลสเตอรอล
molecules.role: Cholesterol mass carried in low-density lipoproteins — historically used as atherogenic risk proxy; imperfect because particle number (ApoB) matters more when TG is high

molecules.name: Apolipoprotein B (ApoB-100)
molecules.label_th: อะโพลิโพโปรตีน บี
molecules.role: One ApoB per atherogenic particle (LDL, VLDL, IDL, Lp(a), chylomicron remnant) — ApoB count = total atherogenic particle burden entering artery wall

molecules.name: Lipoprotein(a) / Lp(a)
molecules.label_th: ไลโปโปรตีน เอ
molecules.role: LDL-like particle with apolipoprotein(a) covalently bound; genetically determined (LPA gene), pro-atherogenic + pro-thrombotic; ~20% of population has elevated Lp(a)

molecules.name: HDL cholesterol (HDL-C)
molecules.label_th: เอชดีแอล คอเลสเตอรอล
molecules.role: Involved in reverse cholesterol transport; U-shaped association with CVD — very high HDL no longer assumed protective (CETP-inhibitor trial failures)

molecules.name: Triglycerides (TG)
molecules.label_th: ไตรกลีเซอไรด์
molecules.role: Carried in VLDL/chylomicrons; TG >150 mg/dL often reflects insulin resistance and discordant ApoB vs LDL-C

molecules.name: Nitric oxide (NO)
molecules.label_th: ไนตริกออกไซด์
molecules.role: Produced by endothelial NO synthase (eNOS) from L-arginine; vasodilator, anti-platelet, anti-inflammatory — NO bioavailability = endothelial health

molecules.name: Endothelial NO synthase (eNOS)
molecules.role: Converts L-arginine → NO + L-citrulline in endothelium; activated by shear stress + insulin; uncoupled (dysfunctional) when BH4 is oxidized

molecules.name: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP)
molecules.role: Hepatic inflammatory marker — residual inflammatory risk after LDL-lowering; core biomarker of CANTOS/JUPITER framework

molecules.name: Homocysteine
molecules.label_th: โฮโมซิสเทอีน
molecules.role: Elevated in B12/folate/B6 deficiency; associated with CVD but causal contribution modest; MTHFR variants affect metabolism

molecules.name: HMG-CoA reductase
molecules.label_th: HMG-CoA รีดักเทส
molecules.role: Target of statins + monacolin K (red yeast rice) — upregulates LDL receptor when inhibited

molecules.name: Oxidized LDL (oxLDL)
molecules.role: LDL trapped in subendothelial space, oxidized by ROS → taken up by macrophage scavenger receptors → foam cell formation

molecules.name: Menaquinone-7 (Vitamin K2-MK7)
molecules.role: Cofactor for γ-glutamyl carboxylase — activates matrix Gla protein (MGP) which inhibits vascular calcification; Rotterdam Study link to lower CHD

molecules.name: Eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA, 20:5 n-3)
molecules.label_th: อีพีเอ (โอเมก้า-3)
molecules.role: Precursor to resolvins/E-series lipid mediators; stabilizes membranes; at high dose (icosapent ethyl 4 g/d) reduced MACE 25% in REDUCE-IT

molecules.name: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA, 22:6 n-3)
molecules.label_th: ดีเอชเอ (โอเมก้า-3)
molecules.role: Dominant n-3 in brain/retina; may raise LDL-C in some subjects; absent from pure EPA formulations (icosapent ethyl)

molecules.name: Nattokinase
molecules.label_th: นัตโตไคเนส
molecules.role: Fibrinolytic enzyme from fermented soy; oral supplement with modest anti-thrombotic effects; NOT a substitute for warfarin/DOAC

molecules.name: Bergamot polyphenolic fraction (BPF)
molecules.label_th: สารสกัดเบอร์กาม็อต
molecules.role: Flavanones (brutieridin, melitidin) with statin-like HMG-CoA modulation; modest LDL reduction in trials

molecules.name: Ubiquinol (reduced CoQ10)
molecules.label_th: ยูบิควินอล / CoQ10
molecules.role: Mitochondrial electron-transport cofactor; depleted downstream of statin HMG-CoA inhibition; may help statin-associated muscle symptoms (modest evidence)

molecules.name: Monacolin K (red yeast rice)
molecules.label_th: โมนาโคลิน เค
molecules.role: Chemically identical to lovastatin — ต้องถือเป็น statin ทางเภสัชวิทยา; stacking with prescription statin = duplicate mechanism + hepatotoxicity risk

organizations.name: Journal of the American College of Cardiology

case_studies.name: REDUCE-IT Trial (Bhatt et al. 2019)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: N=8,179 high-risk patients on statin + elevated TG (135-499 mg/dL): icosapent ethyl 4 g/day reduced MACE 25% (primary composite) and CV death 20% over 4.9 years

case_studies.name: JUPITER Trial (Ridker et al. 2008)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: N=17,802 primary-prevention adults with LDL <130 but hs-CRP ≥2: rosuvastatin 20 mg reduced MACE 44%, stopped early for benefit

case_studies.name: MESA CAC=0 'Warranty Period'
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Participants with CAC=0 had 10-year ASCVD event rates <1% even in the presence of otherwise elevated risk factors — powerful reclassification tool
case_studies.source: Blaha MJ et al., JACC / MESA publications 2015-2017

case_studies.name: INTERHEART Study
case_studies.claim_to_fame: N=29,972 across 52 countries: 9 modifiable risk factors (ApoB/ApoA1 ratio, smoking, HTN, DM, abdominal obesity, stress, diet, alcohol, exercise) accounted for ≥90% of first MI risk worldwide

case_studies.name: Rotterdam K2 Study (Geleijnse et al. 2004)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: N=4,807 elderly: highest tertile dietary menaquinone (K2) intake had ~50% reduction in severe aortic calcification and coronary events over 7 years vs lowest tertile
case_studies.source: Geleijnse JM et al., J Nutr 2004;134:3100-3105

case_studies.name: CANTOS Trial (Ridker et al. 2017)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: IL-1β antibody canakinumab lowered hs-CRP without changing LDL and reduced MACE 15% — proved inflammatory hypothesis of atherosclerosis

case_studies.name: Sniderman ApoB vs LDL-C/Non-HDL-C (2019)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Meta-analysis N>389,000: ApoB hazard ratio for CVD consistently exceeds LDL-C and non-HDL-C; especially when lipids are discordant (high TG, metabolic syndrome)
case_studies.source: Sniderman AD et al., JAMA Cardiol 2019;4:1287-1295
